items.title: Sherrie Maricle interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 4, 2020 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: I love something that Wayne Dyer, a great guru who I love all of his work

ctx.x: Yeah. Okay. Most people are of course connected to their jobs, it’s a huge part of their life. But I think artists and musicians etcetera often times define themselves from what they do. And I’m wondering if you’re feeling sort of a loss of identity with this current situation?

Oh yeah. I mean a lot, you know in my own journey aside from music just in basic mental and self help genres which I am a great consumer of, I love something that Wayne Dyer, a great guru who I love all of his work, he always said, “Well listen, you’re a human being not a human doing because if you stop doing you don’t stop being.” And I loved that. So I think about that all the time and I’m like who am I now that I’m not — I mean we’re all a lot of things. But the way that you function in the world or serve the…
